players.headline: ESPN Fantasy status: Questionable
players.detail: Los Angeles will bring Grupe aboard as its new kicker in place of Harrison Mevis, who was cut after going 0-for-2 on field-goal attempts in Monday's 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills and missing four kicks overall through the first five games of the season. Though he was unable to win the Jets' kicking job coming out of the preseason, Grupe has been a serviceable performer over parts of three NFL campaigns.

players.detail: After missing a second straight week of practice due to a right hamstring injury, Barkley subsequently will be inactive for a second occasion this season.
